subject: SDE2 candidate Jordan Price — proposed offer and comp breakdown
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: SDE2 candidate Jordan Price — proposed offer and comp breakdown

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Attached is the draft offer for Jordan Price (SDE2, IC-2). Quick summary of the proposed package: 
- Base salary: $142,000 
- Target bonus: 10% (standard)
- RSUs: 8,000 over 4 years (1y cliff)
- Sign-on: $7,000 (one-time)
- Start date: target Oct 4, flexible

Context: Jordan interviewed strongly on system design and infra; they have a competing written offer with a slightly higher cash component and asked about equity. Hiring manager (Karthik) has signaled urgency — candidate wants a response this week.

Asking for comp and sign-off: is the mix above OK to send, or would you prefer we bump equity or base? Also flagging that we may need to tweak the sign-on if they push for relocation assistance.

Attachments: offer_draft_v3.pdf, candidate_resume_jordan_price.pdf

Thanks,
Mina
People Operations | Redwood Inference

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDE2 candidate Jordan Price — proposed offer and comp breakdown

Mina — thanks for the summary. Quick thoughts: 
- Base feels slightly low given market for infra SDE2 right now; I'd prefer $145k if comp allows.
- Equity: I'm comfortable with 9,000 RSUs given the candidate's background (distributed systems + prior infra at a scale-up).
- Sign-on: money helps here if they have a competing offer; I'd go up to $10k if Marissa can approve.

If we can get to 145/10%/9k/10k sign-on, I think we have a strong close. If comp team pushes back, prioritize equity over base.

On Mon, Aug 30, 2026 at 9:14 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached is the draft offer for Jordan Price (SDE2, IC-2). Quick summary of the proposed package: ...

Karthik

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDE2 candidate Jordan Price — proposed offer and comp breakdown

Thanks for the context. I reviewed against the SDE2 band for US West. Constraints and approvals below: 
- Approved base up to $142,000 (we are at midpoint for the band). We cannot stretch to $145k without a comp director sign-off.
- Target bonus 10%: approved as standard.
- RSUs: 8,000 approved as the standard offer. Can consider 9,000 only if candidate brings a competitive equity-heavy counter (please document the counter and put through the comp exception workflow).
- Sign-on: approve $7,000 as initial. I can approve up to $10,000 only in documented cases where candidate presents a competing signed offer with cash that materially changes the equation.

If you want to move forward with 9k or $10k sign-on now, I need the candidate's competing offer details and a short justification in the comp_authorization_form.pdf (attached). Also add the standard sign-on clawback language to the offer letter.

Marissa
Total Rewards

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@personalmail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Offer for SDE2 position at Redwood Inference

Jordan — great to speak yesterday. We're excited to extend an offer to join Redwood Inference as an SDE2 on Karthik's team. Summary of the initial offer we are prepared to send (formal PDF attached):

- Base salary: $142,000
- Target bonus: 10% of base
- RSUs: 8,000 units, vesting over 4 years with 1-year cliff
- Sign-on: $7,000 (one-time)
- Tentative start date: Oct 4 (flexible)

Please review and let me know if you'd like to discuss specifics. We know you have a competing opportunity — if you can share the written terms (cash, equity), we are prepared to consider a one-time adjustment.

Next steps: if you accept the terms in principle, I'll route the finalized PDF for e-signature (DocuSign).

Best,
Mina Haddad
People Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: offer_draft_v3.pdf

---
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@personalmail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer for SDE2 position at Redwood Inference

Thanks, Mina — I appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity. A few notes from my side: 
- I'm enthusiastic and would like to move forward, but the other company has offered $150k base + 9k RSUs and a $5k sign-on.
- My preference would be to match on equity to 9k RSUs (I value the long-term upside) and I'd accept the $142k base if equity can be increased. 
- Also asking whether a one-time remote setup stipend is available (~$1,000) and if the start date could be moved up to Sep 20.

Happy to share the competing offer PDF if it's helpful. Looking forward to your response.

Best,
Jordan

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T19:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate counter / final approval request (Jordan Price)

Mina — given the candidate has provided an indication of a written counter that increases equity, I'm approving the following as a one-time exception:
- RSUs: increase to 9,000 (one-time exception)
- Sign-on: increase to $10,000 (one-time exception)
- Remote setup stipend: approve $1,000

Please complete the comp_authorization_form.pdf with the candidate's competing offer attached and route to People Ops records. This exception should be noted as an AOE (approval of exception) and is only for this candidate.

Marissa
Total Rewards

On Aug 31, 2026 at 18:00 Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Can we bump RSUs to 9k and sign-on to $10k as a one-time concession? Candidate indicated a competing offer.

Karthik acknowledged the plan earlier and is fine to proceed.
